original_goal:
[Module: Security Settings | TC-010 | Type: Edge/Interaction | Priority: Medium]
Title: Browser Back after successful password change blocks resubmission with old password

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/security-settings
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "admin",
  "old_password": "Admin123!@#",
  "new_password": "AdminNewPass!1"
}

Preconditions:
  User has just successfully changed their password from Admin123!@# to AdminNewPass!1 and sees the success notification; Security Settings page is open.

Steps to Execute:
  1. After "Password changed successfully." is shown, press browser Back
  2. Without changing any fields (Current Password still contains 'Admin123!@#'), click Change Password again

Expected Result:
  Second submission is blocked; Current Password field shows verification error (old password is now incorrect); no further credential change occurs

Notes from prior verification:
  All placeholders substituted. The verification snapshot confirmed the presence of inputs and the submit button, but the browser Back/prior-success state cannot be validated from a static DOM snapshot; the runtime behavior described in the expected result must be validated during execution.
